descriptionPlain:
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work. 

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.


**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

Team Summary:

The team is led by the VP, Product Marketing with 4 directors and 18 team members, aligned to PCC’s corporate objectives.  This team member will focus on PCC’s top priorities, focusing on new AI Product launches and driving growth across the Skilled Nursing product portfolio. Leading these initiatives is a Director, Product Marketing with 4 direct reports: a Senior PMM, 2 PMMs, and a Associate PMM. 
 

Job Summary:

The Product Marketing Manager establishes clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for Skilled Nursing packages and products that resonates with buyers. This role leads go-to-market planning for new products and releases, equips sales and marketing teams with the tools, content, and training they need to win, and serves as the voice of the market and customer for the product team. By connecting customer insight with product strategy, the Product Marketing Manager helps drive adoption, pipeline, and revenue growth.

lists.content:
Positioning, Messaging & Competitive Strategy 

  • Develop product positioning, value propositions, and messaging that resonate with the buying audience, and produce the source messaging blueprint or positioning guide.
  • Create the competitive comparison guide for use in positioning against similar offerings from other organizations. 
  • Assist in product naming by providing market, competitive, and customer context. 

    • Product Launch & Go-to-Market

  • Lead product introduction and launch planning, including development and measurement of KPIs.
  • Support the launch of new products and releases by defining product positioning and unique selling propositions, and by scoping and creating the required tools and collateral.
  • Develop, enhance, and own distribution of public-facing product launch marketing materials. 

    • Sales Enablement & Sales Support 

  • Communicate the value proposition of the products to the sales team and develop the sales tools that support the selling process for PointClickCare solutions.
  • Partner with the Sales Enablement team to lead sales training on new products and capabilities, including regular updates on product enhancements. 
  • Educate internal sales and marketing teams on ways to concisely demonstrate the strengths and features of our products and enhancements to existing and prospective customers. 
  • Act as a key Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting complex sales inquiries, customer-facing product education, and roadmap updates. 
  • Collaborate with the sales team in complex sales situations, proactively providing clear value propositions, messaging, and tools to leverage in sales scenarios.  

    • Content, Campaigns & Thought Leadership 

  • Collaborate with marketing peers to drive development of a variety of content, including sales decks, solution sheets, customer references, thought leadership, and campaign assets.
  • Work with marketing programs, brand management, and digital marketing teams to ensure appropriate product themes are communicated to the market. 
  • Provide guidance to marketing teams on themes for programs and events, ensuring they are equipped with content to deliver to customers and prospects. 
  • Publicly convey product and market strengths through blogs, presentations, and webinars. 
  • Work with customers to develop case studies, references, and testimonials. 
    •  Market Intelligence, Customer Insight & Product Partnership 
  • Be the expert on our customers, including how and why they buy, their buying criteria, and regulatory considerations, with particular focus on the demands of different segments.
  • Align closely with the product management team to facilitate the appropriate flow of information between teams.
  • Develop and continuously deepen expertise in PointClickCare's products and services to construct and convey industry-leading use case scenarios. 
    •

• Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience 
  • 4-6 years of product marketing experience
  • Experience applying Product Management and/or Product Marketing principles and frameworks, such as Practical Product Management or Pragmatic Marketing 
  • Experience building consensus and collaborating across groups to get things done 
  • Polished professional with an enthusiastic attitude who thrives in fast-paced environments and adapts readily to change
  • AI fluency and/or hands-on use of leading AI solutions

• Advanced degree in business or marketing, or equivalent experience
  • Certification in Pragmatic Marketing or SiriusDecisions Product Marketing 
  • Experience with B2B SaaS healthcare technology (highly preferred)
  • Experience with advanced analytics and/or AI product solutions (highly preferred)

salaryDescription: At PointClickCare, base salary is one of the many components that make up our total rewards package. The Canada base hourly rate for this position is $45.19 - $50.00 ($94,000 - $104,000), non-overtime eligible. Our salary ranges are determined by job and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the target for new hire salaries for the position across all Canada locations. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by job-related skills and knowledge, relevant experience including professional and lived experience, and/or work location. Your recruiter can share more information about our total rewards package during the hiring process.
